title: the fitting check reaches the whole tree
line: once the obituary's subject is accepted, the grandson it writes Matthew Ahern is put to the tree's Matthew Alan Ahearn, placed in another branch of the family, the surname a spelling variant, and the daughter-in-law Noi Davidson to the tree's Noi Davidson, wife of his son: cards for persons the tree holds, never new people; a grandson of a name nobody in the tree carries is still a new person

his son's wife, linked in the tree to the son and not to him: reached the same way
